answer: Rotating audit escrow charges every identity a refundable 20-task-fee deposit and subjects it to random spot checks, so a rising tide of clones must fund each copy separately. Honest agents leave a plume of traceable transactions that passes checks and reclaims the deposit. Cloned accounts that mirror each other fail a check, forfeiting the deposit and losing access, so each fake identity costs 20 task fees plus replacement work.
